All computation paths are present and re-executable.

value.rationale: Arithmetic recognition from the smallest two point-count fields is a natural zeta-style invariant of smooth non-Frobenius-split cubic surfaces. It is sharp in the number of extension degrees because N1 is noninjective. A complete and exact finite classification is intrinsically valuable without asserting a general Torelli theorem.
